summary.text: David Morgan is the Republican candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Sean Brennan is also running.
A machinist, he served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 1985 to 1993 and said in a Ballotpedia survey that his campaign messages are property tax reform, Second Amendment freedom and school reform.

paragraphs.text: David Morgan was born in Niagara Falls, New York, and served in the U.S. Army Reserve from 1985 to 1993.

He graduated from Niagara-Wheatfield Senior High School and earned an associate degree from ITT Technical Institute in 2007, a bachelor's degree from the University of Phoenix in 2015 and a graduate degree from the University of Phoenix in 2017.
His career experience includes working as a driver, in manufacturing and as a machinist.
Morgan advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.

In his 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a Christian, Republican and conservative who is pro-life, pro-Second Amendment and pro-First Amendment, and he named medical freedom as a policy area of focus.
He reported endorsements from the Ohio Republican Party, the Republican Party of Cuyahoga County and Parma Republicans.
